name: real-06-provider-errors
what: The model's server refusing the request: an unknown model (404 and 400) and a refused key (401). Codex retries a 401 five times (`Reconnecting... n/5`) before failing; Tarsee's engine stops the turn at the first one for key providers.

made_with.program: codex 0.167.0 (the real pinned program), started with the argument list, environment and stdin the SDK produced
